voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: Book eighteen. Odysseus drops Irus. Beggars, to your marks.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: Irus is the one on the left.

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: Same head. Same grey beard. Same rags, same staff. Part for part, and colour for colour.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: He means: can we tell them apart?

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: The camera note says: hard to tell apart.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: Book seventeen. Antinous throws the stool. Take two.

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: A third of a second. And it landed outside the frame.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: The experiment. A stool reads as thrown if it is in the air for more than half a second.

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: The variable: the flight, a third of a second to six tenths. And smear bricks.

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: For two drawings the stool is drawn long, in bricks, along its path. The LEGO Movie does it. No blur.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: Held: the voices, the blocking, the lenses. Take three.

voice.speaker: odysseus-as-beggar
voice.caption: I stand like a rock. It's in the book.
